name: Critical Potential [Magic Weapon Special Ability]
body:
Price +2 bonus; Aura moderate Evocation; CL 10th; Slot -; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

A critical potential weapon allows its wielder to gain sudden bursts of arcane potential when they land a critical hit. If the weapon’s critical modifier is x2 they gain 1 point, if it’s x3 they gain 2 points, and if it’s x4 they gain 3 points. The wielder can only gain potential from this ability once per round.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 11,700 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells greater magic weapon; Special creator must have the arcane potential class feature
